theorem actual_normalized_compact_clipped_observables
    {Ω : Type u} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (h : Ω → Ω → ℝ)
    (hh : Measurable (fun t : Ω × Ω => h t.1 t.2))
    (hh2 : MemLp (fun t : Ω × Ω => h t.1 t.2) 2 (μ.prod μ))
    (hhsymm : ∀ o y, h o y = h y o)
    (hcenter : (∫ t : Ω × Ω, h t.1 t.2 ∂(μ.prod μ)) = 0)
    (hprojectionsecond :
      (∫ o, (∫ y, h o y ∂μ) ^ 2 ∂μ) = 1)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    (z : ℝ) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz1 : z ≤ 1)
    (C0 : ℝ) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) :
    let g : Ω → ℝ := fun o => ∫ y, h o y ∂μ
    let r : Ω → Ω → ℝ := fun o y => h o y - g o - g y
    let v : ℝ := ∫ t : Ω × Ω, r t.1 t.2 ^ 2 ∂(μ.prod μ)
    let rho : ℝ := Real.sqrt v
    let N : ℝ := Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)
    let W : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := projectionW n g
    let V : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := projectionV n g
    let D : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := residualStatisticD n r
    let J : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := residualEnergyJ n r
    let Ddel : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := residualStatisticDDeleted n r
    let Jdel : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := residualEnergyJDeleted n r
    let A : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ => |D ξ|
    let Adel : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i => |Ddel ξ i|
    let B1 : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := studentizerClipBudget n r C0 rho 1
    let B1del : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := studentizerClipBudgetDeleted n r C0 rho 1
    let s2 : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := centeredSq n g r
    let s : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ => Real.sqrt (s2 ξ)
    let d : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := centeredDelta n g r
    let e : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := clippedCenteredDelta n g r C0 rho 1
    let Tclip : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := clippedCenteredStatistic n g r C0 rho 1
    let Tactual : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ => if s ξ = 0 then 0 else (W ξ + D ξ) / s ξ
    let cap : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i => min (|g (ξ i)| / N) (1 / (1 + z))
    let deletedTest : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i => cap ξ i * (|A ξ - Adel ξ i| + z * |B1 ξ - B1del ξ i|)
    Measurable W ∧ Measurable V ∧ Measurable D ∧ Measurable J ∧
      Measurable A ∧ Measurable B1 ∧
      Measurable s2 ∧ Measurable s ∧ Measurable d ∧ Measurable e ∧
      Measurable Tclip ∧ Measurable Tactual ∧
      MeasurableSet {ξ : Fin n → Ω | V ξ = 0} ∧
      MeasurableSet {ξ : Fin n → Ω | s ξ = 0} ∧
      (∀ ξ : Fin n → Ω, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + e ξ) ∧
      (∀ ξ : Fin n → Ω, V ξ = 0 →
        d ξ = 0 ∧ e ξ = 0 ∧ Tclip ξ = 0) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n,
        Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => cap ξ i) ∧
        Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => Ddel ξ i) ∧
        Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => Jdel ξ i) ∧
        Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => Adel ξ i) ∧
        Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => B1del ξ i) ∧
        Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => deletedTest ξ i) ∧
        ∃ E : ({j : Fin n // j ≠ i} → Ω) → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ,
          Measurable E ∧
          ∀ ξ : Fin n → Ω,
            (Ddel ξ i, Jdel ξ i, B1del ξ i) =
              E (fun j : {j : Fin n // j ≠ i} => ξ j.val))

theorem actual_quadratic_source_moments
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (h : Ω → Ω → ℝ)
    (hh : Measurable (fun z : Ω × Ω => h z.1 z.2))
    (hh2 : MemLp (fun z : Ω × Ω => h z.1 z.2) 2 (μ.prod μ))
    (hhsymm : ∀ o y, h o y = h y o)
    (hcenter : (∫ z : Ω × Ω, h z.1 z.2 ∂(μ.prod μ)) = 0)
    (hprojectionsecond :
      (∫ o, (∫ y, h o y ∂μ) ^ 2 ∂μ) = 1)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hwindow : x ≤ Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) /
      (2 * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ))) :
    let C : ℝ := Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    let g : Ω → ℝ := fun o => ∫ y, h o y ∂μ
    let r : Ω → Ω → ℝ := fun o y => h o y - g o - g y
    let v : ℝ := ∫ z : Ω × Ω, r z.1 z.2 ^ 2 ∂(μ.prod μ)
    let s : ℝ := 1 + Real.sqrt v
    let a : ℝ := x / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)
    let φ : Ω → ℝ := fun o => a * g o - (a * g o) ^ 2 / 2
    let w : Ω → ℝ := fun o => Real.exp (φ o)
    let m : ℝ := ∫ o, w o ∂μ
    let L : Ω → ℝ := fun o => w o / m
    let ρ : Measure Ω :=
      μ.withDensity (fun o => ENNReal.ofReal (L o))
    let P₀ : Measure (Fin n → Ω) :=
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ)
    let S : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ =>
      ∑ j : Fin n, φ (ξ j)
    let Pₐ : Measure (Fin n → Ω) := P₀.tilted S
    let F : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ =>
      Shao.OQ5.P35.unorderedPairSum (fun i j => r (ξ i) (ξ j))
    let ψ : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i =>
      Shao.OQ6.ResidualDeletion.rowSum
        (fun j k => r (ξ j) (ξ k)) i
    let Λsq : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ =>
      ∑ i : Fin n, ψ ξ i ^ 2
    let A : ℝ :=
      ∫ z : Ω × Ω, r z.1 z.2 ^ 2 ∂(ρ.prod ρ)
    let B : ℝ :=
      ∫ t : Ω × (Ω × Ω), r t.1 t.2.1 * r t.1 t.2.2
        ∂(ρ.prod (ρ.prod ρ))
    let D : ℝ :=
      ∫ d : (Ω × Ω) × (Ω × Ω),
        r d.1.1 d.1.2 * r d.2.1 d.2.2
        ∂((ρ.prod ρ).prod (ρ.prod ρ))
    Measurable g ∧ MemLp g 2 μ ∧ (∫ o, g o ∂μ) = 0 ∧
      (∫ o, g o ^ 2 ∂μ) = 1 ∧
      Measurable (fun z : Ω × Ω => r z.1 z.2) ∧
      MemLp (fun z : Ω × Ω => r z.1 z.2) 2 (μ.prod μ) ∧
      (∀ o y, r o y = r y o) ∧
      (∀ᵐ o ∂μ, (∫ y, r o y ∂μ) = 0) ∧
      0 ≤ v ∧ 1 ≤ s ∧ v ≤ s ^ 2 ∧
      Integrable w μ ∧ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ m ∧ m ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) ∧
      Measurable L ∧ Integrable L μ ∧
      (∀ o, 0 < L o ∧ L o ≤ 2 * C) ∧
      (∫ o, L o ∂μ) = 1 ∧
      Integrable (fun o => (L o - 1) ^ 2) μ ∧
      (∫ o, (L o - 1) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ 4 * C ^ 2 * a ^ 2 ∧
      μ.tilted φ = ρ ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure ρ ∧
      Integrable (fun ξ => Real.exp (S ξ)) P₀ ∧
      (∫ ξ, Real.exp (S ξ) ∂P₀) = m ^ n ∧ 0 < m ^ n ∧
      (∀ ξ, Real.exp (S ξ) / m ^ n =
        ∏ j : Fin n, L (ξ j)) ∧
      Pₐ = P₀.withDensity
        (fun ξ => ENNReal.ofReal (∏ j : Fin n, L (ξ j))) ∧
      Pₐ = Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => ρ) ∧
      IsProbabilityMeasure Pₐ ∧
      MemLp F 2 Pₐ ∧ Integrable (fun ξ => F ξ ^ 2) Pₐ ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, MemLp (fun ξ => ψ ξ i) 2 Pₐ) ∧
      Integrable Λsq Pₐ ∧
      (∫ ξ, F ξ ^ 2 ∂Pₐ) =
        (n.choose 2 : ℝ) * A +
          6 * (n.choose 3 : ℝ) * B +
          6 * (n.choose 4 : ℝ) * D ∧
      (∫ ξ, Λsq ξ ∂Pₐ) =
        2 * (n.choose 2 : ℝ) * A +
          6 * (n.choose 3 : ℝ) * B ∧
      (∫ ξ, F ξ ^ 2 ∂Pₐ) ≤ s ^ 2 *
        (4 * C ^ 2 * (n.choose 2 : ℝ) +
          48 * C ^ 3 * (n.choose 3 : ℝ) * a ^ 2 +
          96 * C ^ 4 * (n.choose 4 : ℝ) * a ^ 4) ∧
      (∫ ξ, Λsq ξ ∂Pₐ) ≤ s ^ 2 *
        (8 * C ^ 2 * (n.choose 2 : ℝ) +
          48 * C ^ 3 * (n.choose 3 : ℝ) * a ^ 2) ∧
      (∫ ξ, F ξ ^ 2 ∂Pₐ) ≤ s ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        (2 * C ^ 2 + 8 * C ^ 3 * x ^ 2 + 4 * C ^ 4 * x ^ 4) ∧
      (∫ ξ, Λsq ξ ∂Pₐ) ≤ s ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        (4 * C ^ 2 + 8 * C ^ 3 * x ^ 2) ∧
      (∫ ξ, F ξ ^ 2 ∂Pₐ) ≤
        14 * C ^ 4 * s ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (1 + x ^ 4) ∧
      (∫ ξ, Λsq ξ ∂Pₐ) ≤
        14 * C ^ 4 * s ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)

theorem actual_quadratic_compact_source_cost
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (h : Ω → Ω → ℝ)
    (hh : Measurable (fun t : Ω × Ω => h t.1 t.2))
    (hh2 : MemLp (fun t : Ω × Ω => h t.1 t.2) 2 (μ.prod μ))
    (hhsymm : ∀ o y, h o y = h y o)
    (hcenter : (∫ t : Ω × Ω, h t.1 t.2 ∂(μ.prod μ)) = 0)
    (hprojectionsecond :
      (∫ o, (∫ y, h o y ∂μ) ^ 2 ∂μ) = 1)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (z : ℝ) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (C₀ : ℝ) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    let g : Ω → ℝ := fun o => ∫ y, h o y ∂μ
    let r : Ω → Ω → ℝ := fun o y => h o y - g o - g y
    let v : ℝ := ∫ t : Ω × Ω, r t.1 t.2 ^ 2 ∂(μ.prod μ)
    let s : ℝ := 1 + Real.sqrt v
    let P₀ : Measure (Fin n → Ω) := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ)
    let projectionTest : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i =>
      Shao.truncationF ((1 + z) * (g (ξ i) / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)))
    let Lcompact : ℝ :=
      ∑ i : Fin n, ∫ ξ, projectionTest ξ i ∂P₀
    let cap : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i =>
      min (|g (ξ i)| / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) (1 / (1 + z))
    let e : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → Fin n → ℝ :=
      fun ξ j k => r (ξ j) (ξ k)
    let F : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ =>
      Shao.OQ5.P35.unorderedPairSum (e ξ)
    let Fdel : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i =>
      Shao.OQ5.P35.unorderedPairSum
        (Shao.OQ6.ResidualDeletion.eraseIncident (e ξ) i)
    let ψ : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ j =>
      Shao.OQ6.ResidualDeletion.rowSum (e ξ) j
    let ψdel : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i j =>
      Shao.OQ6.ResidualDeletion.rowSum
        (Shao.OQ6.ResidualDeletion.eraseIncident (e ξ) i) j
    let Λsq : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ =>
      ∑ j : Fin n, ψ ξ j ^ 2
    let Λdelsq : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i =>
      ∑ j : Fin n, ψdel ξ i j ^ 2
    let D₁ : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ =>
      F ξ / (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1))
    let D₁del : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i =>
      Fdel ξ i / (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1))
    let A : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ => |D₁ ξ|
    let Adel : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i => |D₁del ξ i|
    let B : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ =>
      C₀ * (s / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) +
        Λsq ξ / (s * ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ))))
    let Bdel : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i =>
      C₀ * (s / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) +
        Λdelsq ξ i / (s * ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ))))
    let deletedTest : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i =>
      cap ξ i * (|A ξ - Adel ξ i| + z * |B ξ - Bdel ξ i|)
    let residualCost : ℝ :=
      (∫ ξ, A ξ ∂P₀) + z * (∫ ξ, B ξ ∂P₀) +
        ∑ i : Fin n, ∫ ξ, deletedTest ξ i ∂P₀
    let sourceCost : ℝ := Lcompact + residualCost
    (∀ i : Fin n, Integrable (fun ξ => projectionTest ξ i) P₀) ∧
      Lcompact = (n : ℝ) *
        (∫ o, Shao.truncationF
          ((1 + z) * (g o / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ))) ∂μ) ∧
      0 ≤ Lcompact ∧ Lcompact ≤ (1 + z) ^ 2 ∧
      Integrable A P₀ ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, Integrable (fun ξ => Adel ξ i) P₀) ∧
      Integrable B P₀ ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, Integrable (fun ξ => Bdel ξ i) P₀) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, Integrable
        (fun ξ => cap ξ i * |A ξ - Adel ξ i|) P₀) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, Integrable
        (fun ξ => cap ξ i * |B ξ - Bdel ξ i|) P₀) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, Integrable (fun ξ => deletedTest ξ i) P₀) ∧
      residualCost ≤
        16 * (1 + C₀) * (1 + z) * s / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) ∧
      sourceCost ≤ Lcompact +
        16 * (1 + C₀) * (1 + z) * s / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)

theorem clippedCenteredDelta_bounds (n : ℕ) {Ω : Type u}
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (C0 rho y : ℝ)
    (x : Fin n → Ω) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (hrho : 0 ≤ rho) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + clippedCenteredDelta n g r C0 rho y x ∧
    |clippedCenteredDelta n g r C0 rho y x| ≤
      studentizerClipBudget n r C0 rho y x ∧
    |clippedCenteredDelta n g r C0 rho y x| ≤ |centeredDelta n g r x| ∧
    (0 < projectionV n g x →
      0 < projectionV n g x *
        Real.sqrt (1 + clippedCenteredDelta n g r C0 rho y x))

theorem actual_normalized_remainder_envelope_spec
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (ν : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (ξ Y : Fin n → Ω → ℝ)
    (hξ : ∀ i : Fin n, Measurable (ξ i))
    (hξ2 : ∀ i : Fin n, MemLp (ξ i) 2 ν)
    (hξmean : ∀ i : Fin n, (∫ ω, ξ i ω ∂ν) = 0)
    (hξenergy : (∑ i : Fin n, ∫ ω, (ξ i ω) ^ 2 ∂ν) = 1)
    (hY : ∀ i : Fin n, Measurable (Y i))
    (D1 D2 A B : Ω → ℝ)
    (Adelete Bdelete : Fin n → Ω → ℝ)
    (hD1 : Measurable D1) (hD2 : Measurable D2)
    (hA : Measurable A) (hB : Measurable B)
    (hAnonneg : ∀ ω : Ω, 0 ≤ A ω)
    (hBnonneg : ∀ ω : Ω, 0 ≤ B ω)
    (hD1A : ∀ ω : Ω, |D1 ω| ≤ A ω)
    (hD2B : ∀ ω : Ω, |D2 ω| ≤ B ω)
    (hAint : Integrable A ν) (hBint : Integrable B ν)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hεsmall : ε < 1 / (4 * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)))
    (herr : ∀ (i : Fin n) (ω : Ω), |Y i ω - ξ i ω| ≤ ε)
    (z : ℝ) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    let η : Fin n → Ω → ℝ := Shao.OQ6.ActualMomentNormalization.actualNormalizedFamily ν Y
    let W : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => ∑ i : Fin n, ξ i ω
    let Wη : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => ∑ i : Fin n, η i ω
    let V : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin n, (ξ i ω) ^ 2)
    let Vη : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin n, (η i ω) ^ 2)
    let b : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => Real.sqrt (1 + D2 ω)
    let C : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => Real.sqrt (1 + B ω)
    let H : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => (1 + V ω) * (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) + z * C ω)
    let ρ : ℝ := 4 * ε * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)
    let Dη : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => D1 ω + W ω - Wη ω + z * b ω * (Vη ω - V ω)
    let Aε : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => A ω + ρ * H ω
    let Bε : Ω → ℝ := B
    let Aεdelete : Fin n → Ω → ℝ := Adelete
    let Bεdelete : Fin n → Ω → ℝ := Bdelete
    (∀ i : Fin n, Measurable (η i)) ∧
    Measurable W ∧ Measurable Wη ∧ Measurable V ∧ Measurable Vη ∧
    Measurable b ∧ Measurable C ∧ Measurable H ∧ Measurable Dη ∧
    Measurable Aε ∧ Measurable Bε ∧
    (∀ ω : Ω, 0 ≤ b ω ∧ b ω ≤ C ω) ∧
    (∀ ω : Ω, 0 < H ω) ∧
    0 < ρ ∧ ρ < 1 ∧
    Integrable H ν ∧
    Integrable D1 ν ∧
    Integrable Dη ν ∧
    Integrable Aε ν ∧
    Integrable (fun ω => Dη ω - D1 ω) ν ∧
    Integrable (fun ω => |Dη ω - D1 ω|) ν ∧
    Integrable (fun ω => ρ * H ω) ν ∧
    Integrable (fun ω => A ω + H ω) ν ∧
    (∀ ω : Ω, |Dη ω - D1 ω| ≤ ρ * H ω) ∧
    (∀ ω : Ω, |Dη ω| ≤ Aε ω) ∧
    (∀ ω : Ω, 0 ≤ Aε ω) ∧
    (∀ ω : Ω, Aε ω ≤ A ω + H ω) ∧
    (∀ ω : Ω, 0 ≤ Bε ω ∧ |D2 ω| ≤ Bε ω) ∧
    Bε = B ∧ Aεdelete = Adelete ∧ Bεdelete = Bdelete ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin n) (ω : Ω),
      |Aε ω - Aεdelete i ω| ≤ |A ω - Adelete i ω| + ρ * H ω) ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin n) (ω : Ω),
      |Bε ω - Bεdelete i ω| = |B ω - Bdelete i ω|) ∧
    (∫ ω, |Dη ω - D1 ω| ∂ν) ≤ ρ * (∫ ω, H ω ∂ν) ∧
    (∫ ω, |Aε ω - A ω| ∂ν) = ρ * (∫ ω, H ω ∂ν) ∧
    (∫ ω, Aε ω ∂ν) = (∫ ω, A ω ∂ν) + ρ * (∫ ω, H ω ∂ν)
